title: MDBA Youth Blockchain Hackathon
description:
NO LONGER ACTIVE -This Hackathon is no longer active. The **MDBA Youth Hackathon** is a premier initiative by the Maryland Blockchain Association and the Blockchain Legal Institute designed to empower high school students. This hackathon is limited to students in 10th, 11th and 12th grade, and must have an adult sponsor.

By engaging high schoolers through STEM/TAG programs and community groups, the hackathon fosters real-world skills in blockchain, education, gaming, AI, LegalTech, and sustainable development. Participants will bridge the gap between youth and institutional pipelines, developing deployable prototypes that address societal challenges like anti-corruption and social good. With robust mentorship from industry leaders and blockchain protocols, students gain the expertise and recognition needed to thrive in the emerging tech ecosystem.

PLEASE NOTE: Prize pool is still developing, the amount you see now may not reflect the actual prize amount.

Our Hackathon will be supported by the Caffeine AI team.

Caffeine AI was first demoed at the “World Computer Summit” in Zürich on June 3, and launched in closed alpha at the “Hello, Self-Writing Internet” event in San Francisco on July 15, [Caffeine](https://dfinity.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=33c727489e01ff5b6e1fb6cc6&id=285bdc32e1&e=b917ac9bd2) has quickly evolved from a bold concept into a fast-growing movement.

More than 15,000 early users have joined the Caffeine alpha version, helping to shape the world’s first self-writing app platform. From local promptathons and meetups worldwide to online contests and challenges, the early fast-growing Caffeine community has contributed to building, testing, and shaping what comes next.

As Caffeine opens to everyone, it unlocks a future where a large portion of the world’s apps, websites, and enterprise systems will eventually be self-writing. Businesses will use self-writing apps to power CRMs, ERPs, workflows, and ecommerce. Consumers will create new kinds of software, such as hyperlocal social media for friend groups, side projects, and creative experiments, all by simply chatting with AI.

Learn how to create using Caffeine AI.  Join our discord to obtain your credits to build!

## BLI Legal Tech Hackathon Series

This evaluation rubric is designed specifically for youth participants competing in the **Caffeine AI Track** during the **BLI Legal Tech Hackathon Series**, taking place from **August 22nd through October 31st**.

The goal of this rubric is to measure how effectively you as a youth developer understands practical AI tools, build functional workflows, address legal tech or business challenges, and present their ideas.

### **Scoring Scale**

- **4 – Exemplary:** Exceptional execution; demonstrates deep understanding, initiative, and creativity beyond expected age levels.
- **3 – Proficient:** Consistently meets all criteria; functional solution with clear execution and clear presentation.
- **2 – Developing:** Partial completion; basic functional prototype but requires guidance or lacks full polish.
- **1 – Beginning:** Minimal attempt; incomplete project or limited understanding of AI application.

### **Score Breakdown & Point Values**

- **AI Concept & Problem Definition:** 20 Points Max
- **Technical Execution & Functionality:** 25 Points Max
- **Practical Legal & Business Utility:** 25 Points Max
- **Responsible AI & Ethics:** 15 Points Max
- **Presentation & Project Pitch:** 15 Points Max
- **Total Score:** 100 Points

### **Youth Developer Milestones & Key Dates**

- 🚀 **Hackathon Launch:** August 22nd
- 📤 **Project Submission Deadline:** October 31st at 11:59 PM
- ⚖️ **Judging Period:** November 1st
- 🏆 **Awards Ceremony:** December 12th

**To obtain your Caffeine AI credits to start building, you need to join the discord.**
